description: Kiro V3 ACP provider fork (vendored tobenwarrior/hermes-kiro-provider, V3 primary, V2 selectable fallback, first upstream contribution prepared), Hermes v0.22.2 install and wiring, capability tiers locked/research/self_improve (default self_improve) with the root-enforced skill gate, and the assistant backend (chat backend, relay gate, attachments with caps and metadata stripping without Pillow, vision role, voice fallback, per-feature stores, reverse-image hook, selftest), plus the live V3/Hermes/research/food-photo checks. Depends on FEAT-005 and FEAT-006. Plan: docs/PLAN.md (Kiro V3 ACP provider fork, Hermes, capability tiers, assistant backend). Requirement rows: docs/TRACEABILITY.md.
steps: Item 33: Research first (§23 items 5c, 10–13, 28–30; rows DES-V-*, CR2-3c). Re-fetch the Kiro manifest (bump the pin if 3.x is out), the V3 ACP migration, ACP and auth pages, Hermes v0.22.2 docs (skills loading and write paths, native web tools and `HTTPS_PROXY`, `/v1/responses` input parts and streaming, state layout). Record in the ADR-0002 addendum before coding. Carried detail from the interrupted planner draft (FEAT numbers remapped; DESIGN revision 5 and the item text above win on any conflict, e.g. no Pillow in the gatekeeper, streaming via drafts, decision services from FEAT-005): Draft item 11: research first, record before coding. Re-fetch https://desktop-release.q.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/latest/manifest.json (2026-10-18: still 2.32.0). If a 3.x CLI is out: bump kiro_cli in config/versions.lock.yaml (version, url, sha256 from the manifest), update the ADR-0011 addendum, and let the images step rebuild sandbox-llm (probe tuple changes, so FEAT-006's probes must pass again: rerun ossctl doctor --probes). If not: stay on 2.32.0 with --v3 / --agent-engine=v3 and record that. Read the V3 ACP migration guide https://kiro.dev/docs/cli/v3/acp-migration/ (the page is client-rendered; if web_fetch returns only the footer, use web search results, the docs repo/raw markdown, or 'kiro-cli acp --help' from the pinned binary) plus the ACP and auth pages; verify DESIGN §23 items 10, 11, 12, 5c (V3 ACP auth with an API key: env KIRO_API_KEY vs --auth-method=client + _kiro/auth/getAccessToken; currentModeId and advertised tool-list field names; set_config_option ids 'model'/'effortLevel'; promptCapabilities.image/audio for FEAT-007). Record everything in a new 'Implementation addendum (FEAT-007)' in docs/adr/0002-agent-runtime-hermes-kiro-acp.md.

Item 34: Vendored provider fork (§15.2; rows CHAT-5, CHAT-6, ADR-0002, DES-AC-20). Import `tobenwarrior/hermes-kiro-provider@02c4dd06` unmodified as its own commit (`vendor/hermes-kiro-provider/`, `LICENSE`, `UPSTREAM_COMMIT`, `UPSTREAM_URL`), then add `kiro_acp/{v3_core.py,v3.py,hermes_plugin.py}` with `HERMES_KIRO_ACP_ENGINE=v3|v2` (V2 code untouched = the fallback), non-editable uv path dependency; `tests/fakes/fake_acp_v3.py`, `tests/acp/{test_v3_contract,test_mode_mismatch,test_hermes_probe_eval,test_model_switch,test_image_blocks}.py`. Prepare the upstream bundle for `ossctl contribution import` (the first contribution; it still needs both gates). Carried detail from the interrupted planner draft (FEAT numbers remapped; DESIGN revision 5 and the item text above win on any conflict, e.g. no Pillow in the gatekeeper, streaming via drafts, decision services from FEAT-005): Draft item 12: vendor the provider. Download tobenwarrior/hermes-kiro-provider at 02c4dd06585436751145961658a22b773f23a0ef as the commit archive (https://codeload.github.com/tobenwarrior/hermes-kiro-provider/tar.gz/02c4dd06585436751145961658a22b773f23a0ef) into the gitignored d:\Work\autonomous-oss-contributor\.ossbot-local\vendor-src\ (never a submodule, never a remote of this repo), copy into vendor/hermes-kiro-provider/ as plain files keeping LICENSE (MIT), add UPSTREAM_COMMIT and UPSTREAM_URL, and commit it UNMODIFIED alone ('chore(vendor): import hermes-kiro-provider@02c4dd0 unmodified'). Then add: kiro_acp/v3_core.py (stdlib only: launch_spec() -> ['/home/hermes/.local/bin/kiro-cli','acp','--agent-engine=v3'(+ '--auth-method=client' if item 11 says so)], cwd /home/hermes/.hermes/kiro-cwd, env HTTPS_PROXY=http://10.212.0.2:3141; session_new_params() with _meta.kiro {modeId:'ossbot-chat', modelId, effortLevel} from models.yaml roles.chat via the resolved id; assert_surface(session) with expected_mode/allowed_tools; permission answering reject_once > reject_always > cancelled, never synthesized options, never _meta.kiro.consent; NDJSON JSON-RPC framing with Section 20 size limits; -32601 for unknown agent->client requests; a redacting JSON-RPC logger that never logs the result of _kiro/auth/getAccessToken), kiro_acp/v3.py (Hermes provider glue on the upstream external_process seam: handlers registered before session/new, capability gating on agentCapabilities/_meta.kiro.extensionMethods, model/effort switch via session/set_config_option before each session/prompt when the resolved chat model changed (mtime-cached models.yaml), never session/set_model, turn completes on the session/prompt response, transport drop -> re-register + session/load without resending, on_surface_violation hook), kiro_acp/hermes_plugin.py (registration; the plugin manifest names it; kiro_acp/__init__.py stays import-free, R5-N3), engine selection HERMES_KIRO_ACP_ENGINE=v3|v2 (v3 default; V2 code path untouched). The upstream shim extends Hermes's in-tree copilot-acp client and its file-safety bridge: the V3 adapter must not expose any file bridge capability to the agent (record how in the ADR addendum). Declare vendor/hermes-kiro-provider as a non-editable uv path dependency in pyproject.toml, uv lock, sync DEV and ROOTDEV venvs. Tests: tests/fakes/fake_acp_v3.py (scripted NDJSON JSON-RPC stdio server) and tests/acp/{test_v3_contract.py,test_mode_mismatch.py,test_hermes_probe_eval.py,test_model_switch.py} covering AC 20 (capability gating, _meta.kiro on session/new, set_config_option never set_model, reject options or cancelled, unknown request -> JSON-RPC error, access token absent from every log record, argv has --agent-engine=v3 and none of --agent/--model/--effort/--trust-*, mode vibe or an advertised read tool -> no session/prompt and kill requested, model change between turns -> exactly one set_config_option).

Item 35: Hermes install and wiring (§15.1, §15.4; rows DES-FR-1b, DES-AC-1 hermes part). Provision steps `kiro-cli for hermes` and `hermes` (R5-N2 lock), `hermes/config/{config.yaml.j2,permissions.yaml}` rendered per tier, `hermes/plugins/ossbot/` (status, queue, contribution, logs, request_discovery, notify, pause, kill, `request_sandbox_job`, feature registry), `.kiro/agents/ossbot-chat.json`, units `ossbot-hermes.service` (full non-root hardening, ProtectHome=tmpfs), `ossbot-hermes-probe.socket` + `@.service`, `ctl/hermes_probe.py`, `ossctl hermes upgrade|login|probe`, `ossctl kiro upgrade`, doctor checks. Carried detail from the interrupted planner draft (FEAT numbers remapped; DESIGN revision 5 and the item text above win on any conflict, e.g. no Pillow in the gatekeeper, streaming via drafts, decision services from FEAT-005): Draft item 13: Hermes install and wiring. Replace the Decision 8 no-ops in scripts/lib/{kiro.sh,hermes.sh} and scripts/provision.sh: step 'kiro-cli for hermes' (manifest + sha256 tarball into /home/hermes/.local/bin, the shared sandbox/kiro/settings/cli.json and a hermes permissions.yaml denying shell/read/write/glob/grep and ~/.kiro/**, /proc/**, /sys/**, /dev/**, /run/**, /etc/**) and step 'hermes' (DESIGN §15.4 script verbatim in intent + R5-N2: flock /run/ossbot/hermes-upgrade.lock for the whole step, stop ossbot-hermes-probe.socket first, repeat the pgrep -u hermes refusal after the rollback pkill); record the peeled commit (git rev-parse v0.22.2^{commit}) as hermes.peeled_commit in config/versions.lock.yaml; read the tag's setup-hermes.sh and reproduce only its non-dependency steps (list them in the ADR-0002 addendum, §23 item 13). Add hermes/config/{config.yaml.j2,permissions.yaml} (allowlisted toolsets of §15.1 rendered from a tier parameter defaulting to 'locked' - FEAT-007 adds the other tiers; tool_search off and verify how v0.22.2 parses it; approvals/cron/unattended keys verified at v0.22.2), hermes/plugins/ossbot/{plugin.yaml,__init__.py,tools.py} (ossbot_status, ossbot_queue, ossbot_contribution, ossbot_logs, ossbot_request_discovery, ossbot_notify, ossbot_pause, ossbot_kill over the gatekeeper UDS; never imports ossbot.gatekeeper), .kiro/agents/ossbot-chat.json (tools web_search, web_fetch only), systemd/ossbot-hermes.service (User=hermes, API server on 127.0.0.1:8642, egress only via 3141, the full non-root hardening pattern with ProtectHome=tmpfs + BindPaths=/home/hermes so /run/user stays hidden, P1-17), systemd/ossbot-hermes-probe.socket (/run/ossbot/hermes-probe.sock, SocketGroup=gatekeeper, 0660, Accept=yes, MaxConnections=1) + ossbot-hermes-probe@.service (root oneshot, ConditionPathExists=!killed); all added to OSSBOT_ENABLE_UNITS, the kill stop list and tests/system/lib.sh. src/ossbot/ctl/hermes_probe.py (root ACP client + evaluator per §15.2: python -I, imports kiro_acp only from /opt/ossbot/app/vendor/hermes-kiro-provider, adapter_sha256 drift check with O_NOFOLLOW, runuser -u hermes for kiro-cli, deterministic pass rule over the NDJSON, result to /var/lib/ossbot/probes/hermes-kiro.json root:gatekeeper 0640, non-blocking upgrade lock -> inconclusive 'Hermes is upgrading', --selftest, --handshake-only per PLAN Decision 11). ossctl 'hermes upgrade|login|probe' and 'kiro upgrade'. Doctor: replace the three Hermes SKIP checks (commit vs lock, hermes-side Kiro probe, kiro settings (hermes)) and add 'chat relay' state. tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh: add hermes:127.0.0.1:8642 to the host-listener allowlist and probe the new units. Tests: tests/unit/ctl/test_hermes_probe_paths.py (code origin under the root copy, PYTHONPATH ignored under -I, drift -> adapter_drift), tests/system/test_hermes_install_hygiene.sh (incl. the mid-upgrade probe-trigger case), tests/unit/test_systemd_units.py extended.

Item 36: Capability tiers and the skill gate (§15.5; rows CR2-3a backend, CR2-3b, CR2-3d backend, CR2-3e, CR2-3f, CR2-3g, CR2-6a, ADR-0018, DES-AC-25, DES-AC-35 backend). Tier flag (default `self_improve`, unparseable → `locked`), `POST /v1/control/hermes-tier` (human), `ossctl hermes tier`, root `ossbot-hermes-tier.path/.service` (re-render as root with `O_NOFOLLOW`, restart Hermes, re-run probe and surface check, invalidate skill approvals `tier_changed`); `chat/hermes_surface.py` with per-tier allowlists; skill staging dir, root hasher writing `skill_reviews`, `SkillApprovals` content binding (file hashes, tools, tier), root activation into the read-only active dir, doctor drift check. If v0.22.2 cannot separate staging from active skills, stop and ask (send_message warning) instead of shipping an ungated tier. Carried detail from the interrupted planner draft (FEAT numbers remapped; DESIGN revision 5 and the item text above win on any conflict, e.g. no Pillow in the gatekeeper, streaming via drafts, decision services from FEAT-005): Draft item 17: Hermes capability tiers (CR-002 req 3, 6). Tier state in /var/lib/ossbot/control/hermes-tier (default from policy.yaml hermes.capability_tier_default: self_improve; unparseable -> locked). hermes/config/config.yaml.j2 renders per tier: locked = FEAT-007 allowlist; research = + Hermes-native web tools only if v0.22.2 routes them through HTTPS_PROXY 3141 (verify; otherwise research = locked + Kiro web tools and record it); self_improve = research + skills (skill_manage, skill_view, skills_list). terminal, code_execution, file, browser, delegation, cronjob stay disabled in every tier; memory on in all. The gatekeeper surface check (chat/hermes_surface.py) uses the tier's allowlist; mismatch is still a soft kill. Switching: Telegram /hermes tier <tier> (go, two-tap) and 'ossctl hermes tier <tier>' -> flag -> root ossbot-hermes-tier.path/.service re-renders ~hermes/.hermes/config.yaml as root (O_NOFOLLOW, refuse symlinks), restarts ossbot-hermes, re-runs the hermes-side probe and the surface check before the relay reopens. Skills gate: verify how v0.22.2 loads skills (directories, external dirs, write location). Hermes writes new/changed skills only to a staging dir; the gatekeeper detects them (root-run hasher via the probe socket or a root timer writing /var/lib/ossbot/skills/pending.json) and sends a skill card (escaped diff in <pre>, [Approve] [Reject], same two-tap single-use message-bound tokens: purposes skill_approve, skill_confirm, skill_reject; table skill_reviews in the next free migration number); on Confirm root copies the skill into the read-only active dir (root:hermes 0750 dirs, 0640 files), records sha256; doctor detects drift; a skill can never grant tools above the tier (the config, not the skill, defines toolsets). If v0.22.2 cannot keep staging and active apart, do NOT ship an ungated skills tier: stop and send_message severity 'warning' describing the gap and the alternative (self_improve degraded to research until fixed).

Item 37: Assistant backend (§15.6; rows DES-FR-13, CR2-7a, CR2-7c…7g, CR2-7i, CR2-7j, CR3-AC-36, DES-AC-36 backend). `gatekeeper/chat/{backend,hermes_api,turns,media,imgmeta}.py`: `ChatBackend`, `HermesApiBackend` (`/v1/responses`, session keys, streaming deltas when available, cancel), relay gate (surface check + probe file younger than 2 h), `chat_turns` table, attachment download via `getFile` through 3150 (cap 20 MB, allowlist images/PDF/text/audio, per-conversation dir readable by `hermes`), metadata walker (JPEG APP1/EXIF/XMP, PNG `eXIf`/`tEXt`/`iTXt`/`zTXt`, WebP `EXIF`/`XMP `; HEIC refused as "send it as a photo"; pixels byte-identical; fuzz test), image turns on the `vision` role, voice fallback, per-feature SQLite store pattern in the plugin, reverse-image-search secret hook in `scripts/setup-secrets.*` plus a skill stub, `POST /v1/chat/selftest` (operator) and `ossctl chat selftest`. Rendering, routing and streaming UI are FEAT-009/010.

Item 38: Redeploy and live checks, then commit FEAT-007 (rows NOTE-3 hermes part, NOTE-4, CR2-4, CR2-7l live part). Real handshake recorded in ADR-0002; Hermes-key headless `--v3` round-trip; `ossctl hermes probe` passes; a real V3 ACP session through the fork via the selftest (answer delivered to the owner only); live chat model switch without restart; a current-info question returns a sourced answer and the proxy log shows (or the ADR documents the absence of) Kiro web calls via 3141; a `*.github.io` page and a gist fetched from research and Hermes; a food photo returns an estimate. Key problems go to "User action needed" in `docs/FINAL_REPORT.md`. Carried detail from the interrupted planner draft (FEAT numbers remapped; DESIGN revision 5 and the item text above win on any conflict, e.g. no Pillow in the gatekeeper, streaming via drafts, decision services from FEAT-005): Draft item 14: redeploy twice (bootstrap -Only provision; second run only 'unchanged'), confirm versions as hermes, run the real handshake ROOT /opt/ossbot/app/.venv/bin/python -I -m ossbot.ctl.hermes_probe --handshake-only and append the redacted outcome to the ADR-0002 addendum, run the hermetic bar and the system tests. Carried detail from the interrupted planner draft (FEAT numbers remapped; DESIGN revision 5 and the item text above win on any conflict, e.g. no Pillow in the gatekeeper, streaming via drafts, decision services from FEAT-005): Draft item 15: LIVE checks with the 'ossbot-hermes' key through product code only (results in docs/VERIFICATION.md '## Phase 2 live checks'): (a) Kiro headless --v3 round-trip with the Hermes key: extend 'ossctl kiro smoke --key hermes' (root runs runuser -u hermes -- kiro-cli chat --v3 --no-interactive --agent ossbot-chat --output-format stream-json with the env loaded by root code from hermes.env, canned JSON prompt, nothing secret printed); (b) 'ossctl hermes probe' passes with the real key (relay gate opens; if auth option (a) fails, try (b) per §15.2 and record which works; (c) device flow needs the user and is only reported); (c) a REAL V3 ACP session through the forked provider: add gatekeeper endpoint POST /v1/chat/selftest (operator role) that relays one fixed prompt through ChatBackend -> Hermes -> kiro-acp v3 and returns redacted metadata (engine, mode, model, latency, answer length); run it via 'ossctl chat selftest' and also deliver the 🤖 answer to the configured user's Telegram chat; (d) live chat model switch: 'ossctl model set chat <another catalog id>' then selftest again shows one session/set_config_option and the new model (Hermes not restarted); set it back and commit config/models.yaml only if it changed; (e) doctor shows the relay enabled. If a check fails because of the key (API keys not enabled for ACP, org policy), record it under 'User action needed' in docs/FINAL_REPORT.md and leave the relay disabled; do not work around it. Set status completed, write findings (Hermes state layout for backups: memory/session files and paths; auth option that works; mode/tool fields; set_config_option ids; image/audio prompt capabilities), commit locally. Carried detail from the interrupted planner draft (FEAT numbers remapped; DESIGN revision 5 and the item text above win on any conflict, e.g. no Pillow in the gatekeeper, streaming via drafts, decision services from FEAT-005): Draft item 20: LIVE checks (CR-002 req 4 + Amendment A tests), results in docs/VERIFICATION.md '## Phase 2 live checks': through POST /v1/chat/selftest (extend it to accept a fixture attachment) send (a) a question that needs current web info -> sourced answer; confirm in the proxy log that the Kiro web_search/web_fetch traffic went through 3141 (or document that Kiro's web tools run server-side and what that means for egress control); (b) a github.io page and a public gist fetched from the research profile and from Hermes; (c) the food-photo check with a public-domain fixture image under tests/fixtures/ (record the estimate; accuracy is not graded); answers go to the configured user's Telegram only. Default mode open and tier self_improve are active and shown by /status and doctor. Set status completed, write findings (mode/tier mechanics, skills dirs, attachment dir layout for backups, Hermes streaming support), commit locally.
